indicator.definition: Police Scotland provisional originally suspected drug deaths; not NRS registered deaths or population-adjusted risk.
indicator.original_reporting_qualification: Provisional originally suspected deaths, legacy ten-day timing adjustment; police divisions are not councils or Greenock; x suppression retained; no significance test.
indicator.calculation_method: Adjacent exact-period differences; percent change only for nonzero reference; complete-window arithmetic means; no inference or significance test

limitations: Frozen retrospective research output; not live conditions or a validated warning
Source periods, populations, geographies and measurement definitions must remain distinct
